plugins.description: The UK public-procurement co-pilot. Ask how to buy across the public sector, where to sell as a vendor, or how public money flows — source-anchored across 3,200 frameworks, 117k catalogue listings and 658k real awards, with the Procurement Act 2023 built in. Ships the govbuy MCP server + a skill + slash commands.
